reviews.comment: Professor Sorescu is incredible and truly cares about her students!! If you do the work, it's an easy A. Classes include a lecture and an activity. Required to read over brief notes before every class and take easy 6-question quiz. Quizzes help study for exams which aren't tricky. The group project is a lot of work but fun. I highly recommend her!

There are at least 2 online quizzes every week, a group project, two tests, and a cumulative final exam. Not a bad professor, but so much unnecessary work. I would rather take literally anyone else. She cares a lot about what she teaches, but the class is so boring. In every class, there is a class activity you have to submit for attendance.
